locations.label: Outside LOGAN LABS
locations.body: Return to the city outside this building.

locations.label: ROAR racecar
locations.body: An open-wheel racer with a LiDAR mast above the cockpit. The original city puts this car beside its researcher.

locations.label: Scrabble table
locations.body: The bot left QUIXOTIC on the board. Pull up a game and take the next turn.

locations.label: CalSol solar racer
locations.body: The solar cells cover the deck around the driver. This is the companion to the open-wheel ROAR car across the lab.

locations.label: Fabrication bench
locations.body: Three spools, a warm print bed, and a half-finished part. The tool drawer holds crimpers, flux, zip ties, and one mystery bolt.

locations.label: TūīNet listening post
locations.body: A tūī watches the field microphone from its perch, just like the one in the pixel lab.

locations.label: Welcome to the fast corner! Th
pages: Welcome to the fast corner! This is ROAR localization — DLIO++ keeping an autonomous racecar locked onto its pose.
C++, Python, and ROS 2. A car can't brake late if it doesn't know where it is.

locations.label: Careful
pages: Careful, that's the Gen XI solar car! CalSol races it in the 2026 American Solar Challenge.
KiCad boards, C++ firmware, and every drop of sunshine we can catch.

locations.label: This terminal runs KITE
pages: This terminal runs KITE — an AI email assistant that turns your inbox into a queryable database.
Natural-language search, thread summaries, context-aware replies, automatic calendar wrangling...

locations.label: Shh
pages: Shh — it's listening! TūīNet identifies New Zealand's native birds by song, with AI audio recognition on a Raspberry Pi.
It reports home over OWL's ClusterDuck mesh from forests with no signal at all.

locations.label: Fancy a word game? This SCRABB
pages: Fancy a word game? This SCRABBLE BOT finds optimal plays with a DAWG dictionary and board heuristics.
I have never beaten it. I am at peace with this.
